meta.title: Book a 20-Minute Call | Everstead for Professionals
meta.description: Advisers, solicitors, care providers, HR teams: book a 20-minute call with the founding team. No pitch, no contract, just a conversation about whether Everstead fits the families you serve.
meta.ogTitle: Book a Call | Everstead for Professionals
meta.ogDescription: A 20-minute call with the founding team to see whether Everstead fits your clients, residents or employees.

hero.title: Tell us who you serve. We will show you what fits.
hero.subtitle: A 20-minute call with the founding team, for advisers, solicitors, care providers, HR teams and anyone else whose work meets families at a difficult moment. No pitch, no contract.

coverage.title: What we will cover
benefits: What your clients, residents or employees would actually use, from the free plan to the adviser portal
For advisers and solicitors: readiness scores, document review and requests, all on the client's consent
For care providers and employers: the Emergency Pack and a free plan to hand out, with nothing stored on your side
The trust and data-protection model you can repeat to the people you serve
What a pilot with your organisation would look like; you set the agenda

infoCards.title: 20-minute session
infoCards.body: We confirm a time within one business day. Longer if you need it.

infoCards.title: Bring your team
infoCards.body: Include colleagues from legal, advice, care, HR, operations or client success.

infoCards.title: No liability created
infoCards.body: Everstead is an organisation tool, not a regulated service. We will explain exactly where the boundaries are.

infoCards.title: Advisers, solicitors, care, HR
infoCards.body: We are working with a small first group across these fields to shape what each one needs.

role.label: Role
role.placeholder: IFA, solicitor, care manager, HR lead…

clients.label: Roughly how many clients, residents or employees?

notes.label: What matters most to you in this conversation?
notes.placeholder: Data handling, probate workflows, family communication, employee wellbeing…

form.disclaimer: Everstead is an organisation and access tool, not a legal or financial service. No regulated advice is given on this call.

sent.title: We'll be in touch.
sent.body: We'll reach out within one business day to find a time that works. In the meantime, feel free to explore the security and data promise pages.
